quote: God knows I never sought anything in you except yourself; I wanted simply you, nothing of yours.
source: Heloise, The Letters of Abelard and Heloise, Letter 2, Heloise to Abelard (trans. Betty Radice, 1974)
note: Corrected the citation. The wording is Betty Radice’s and the letter is Heloise’s first to Abelard, Letter 2 in that edition. The page reference is dropped because p. 51 could not be confirmed against the 1974 Penguin text. The letter number locates the passage.
